title: aloysia lycioides var. paraguariensis
intro: Aloysia lycioides var. paraguariensis, commonly known as Paraguayan yerba louisa, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety, and acting as a natural relaxant due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents of Aloysia lycioides var. paraguariensis include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
